result.title: Learning Evidence-Grounded Reasoning for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
result.summary: LLM-driven time series forecasting has become increasingly promising by leveraging contextual features to generate future values directly or refine forecast priors. However, incorporating contextual features alone does not ensure that models can identify which features matter for forecasting and understand what they suggest about future dynamics. We argue that the fundamental challenge is how to extract predictive evidence from contextual features and when and how to leverage it to guide forecasting decisions. In this paper, we propose CastReasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model for context-aware time series forecasting. Specifically, CastReasoner uses a structured chain of thought (CoT) to extract predictive evidence from contextual features, infer the future dynamics suggested by this evidence, and assess these dynamics against the forecast prior to guide adaptive forecasting decisions. To enable this capability, we design a reasoning-centric two-stage post-training framework including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). First, we synthesize reasoning trajectories through controllable multi-teacher guidance and select high-quality ones using a novel student-aware difficulty metric. Second, we design fine-grained multi-objective rewards to further improve reasoning and forecasting. To address heterogeneous learning needs across domains in both stages, we introduce a convergence-guided data balancing strategy. Through this two-stage training, CastReasoner improves both reasoning quality and predictive accuracy. Extensive experiments across multi-domain forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that CastReasoner achieves superior forecasting performance.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 CastReasoner，用结构化 CoT 从上下文特征中抽取预测证据、推断未来动态，并与预测先验比对以调整预测；训练采用 SFT 合成轨迹加 RL 多目标奖励的两阶段后训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 时间序列领域而非视觉，但其「抽取证据—判断何时及如何使用证据—调整决策」的结构，以及学生感知难度筛选轨迹、细粒度多目标和数据平衡策略，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、轨迹监督与贡献分配的设计线索。
